title: Silver Oak Capital added to Spear’s 500 list for 2022
summary: Not a deal case study: a news/award item filed under /case-studies/. Per the search tool's summaries, the page announces that Silver Oak Capital and its founder Jimmy Baillie were included in the Spear's 500 list (stated on the page as 2022/2023; the title says 2022) and links to Baillie's full adviser profile on spears500.com. The page is reported to say the firm was set up in 2019 after Baillie saw a gap in specialist advice for loans of £2 million and above. The linked Spear's 500 profile (spears500.com/adviser/22953/jimmy-baillie) describes the firm as advising high-net-worth clients on secured loans of roughly £2m to £20m, arranging real estate debt in the UK, Western Europe, Southern Africa and the Middle East, with a network of more than 800 lenders worldwide. No deal amount, asset, borrower, lender, structure, timing, challenge or outcome applies; no publication date, author, H1 or meta description was revealed by the search results.
